ticket.summary: Upstairs toilet (12 yrs old) has been running continuously for a few days; customer booked a standard rebuild visit.
mitigation_advice: Close the toilet's supply shutoff valve (small oval handle under the fixture, clockwise until snug) between uses to stop water waste [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Running toilet rebuild (fill+flush valve), parts and labor included

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Nora - Sept 1 at 3:00 PM, 402 Ashgrove Ter, running toilet rebuild at $189 all-in (about an hour on site). Your tech will text when they're on the way. Until then, feel free to close the toilet's shutoff valve between uses to save water [PB-01]. Thanks for texting us!
